title: [MAIN][All-e]Source Currency Inconsistency for LCY Postings and cash posting on sales documents
summary: Source currency is now consistently applied to local currency postings and cash posting on sales documents, fixing an inconsistency in how currency is handled during general ledger postings across the system.
key_points: Corrects currency handling in general ledger posting for LCY transactions
